title: Principal quotient preserves quasi-isomorphisms on regular complexes
statement: Let R,A be commutative rings and f:R→A a surjective ring map with kernel tR. Let g:C→D be a quasi-isomorphism of unbounded cochain complexes of R-modules. Suppose multiplication by t is injective on each term of C and D. Then extension of scalars along f takes g to a quasi-isomorphism of A-module complexes.

proof.text: The tensor unit M→Res(A⊗_R M) is onto, and its kernel is tM: prove surjectivity on pure tensors using surjectivity of f, and tensor the right-exact sequence R --t→ R --f→ A.

proof.text: Form the degreewise short exact sequences C --t→ C →Res(A⊗C) and D --t→ D →Res(A⊗D). Naturality gives a morphism of short exact sequences. The homology long exact sequence and its quasi-isomorphism criterion give the third quasi-isomorphism from the first two. Exact faithful restriction of scalars reflects it. No boundedness is used.
